{
  "meta": {
    "title": "Token bucket in a shared store",
    "topicClass": "concept",
    "format": "full",
    "targetLengthSec": 65
  },
  "story": {
    "devices": [
      "planted_question",
      "real_incident",
      "failure_before_fix",
      "what_breaks"
    ],
    "runningExample": "One free-tier client with API key 7781 calls the search route through the Hollowmere gateway, spending tokens from its bucket.",
    "chapters": [
      {
        "id": "ch-1",
        "title": "The bucket"
      },
      {
        "id": "ch-2",
        "title": "One shared store"
      },
      {
        "id": "ch-3",
        "title": "Slow store, 40x limit"
      }
    ],
    "beats": [
      {
        "id": "beat-1",
        "chapterId": "ch-3",
        "intent": "Show a real checkout outage: store failover added latency and 31% of checkouts failed for 47 minutes, making the cost of a slow store concrete.",
        "device": "real_incident",
        "targetSec": 9,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-19",
          "fact-20",
          "num-18",
          "num-19",
          "num-20",
          "num-21"
        ],
        "layoutMode": "pipeline",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": [],
        "source": "Larkspur Pay platform team, 14 March 2025"
      },
      {
        "id": "beat-2",
        "chapterId": "ch-3",
        "intent": "Ask the unanswered question: how did a 300 req/s limit become 12,000 req/s when the store got slow?",
        "device": "planted_question",
        "targetSec": 6,
        "factIds": [
          "num-24",
          "num-23",
          "fact-21"
        ],
        "layoutMode": "centered_focus",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": []
      },
      {
        "id": "beat-3",
        "chapterId": "ch-1",
        "intent": "Show the naive fixed-window limiter allowing twice the limit at a minute boundary, so the need for a different design is visible.",
        "device": "failure_before_fix",
        "targetSec": 11,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-9",
          "num-6"
        ],
        "layoutMode": "cycle",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": []
      },
      {
        "id": "beat-4",
        "chapterId": "ch-1",
        "intent": "Replace it with a token bucket: one free-tier key with capacity 100 and refill 10/s spends one token per request.",
        "targetSec": 12,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-1",
          "fact-2",
          "fact-5",
          "num-1",
          "num-2"
        ],
        "layoutMode": "centered_focus",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": [
          "token bucket"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "beat-5",
        "chapterId": "ch-2",
        "intent": "Demonstrate why the bucket must live in a shared store with an atomic check: two gateway nodes otherwise both see the last token and both pass a request.",
        "device": "what_breaks",
        "targetSec": 13,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-6",
          "fact-7",
          "num-3"
        ],
        "layoutMode": "hub_spoke",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [
          "atomic_lock"
        ],
        "newTerms": [
          "shared store"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "beat-6",
        "chapterId": "ch-3",
        "intent": "Pay off the question: when store calls exceed the 50 ms timeout and the limiter fails open, 40 instances enforce the full limit locally and send 40x the contracted rate.",
        "device": "real_incident",
        "targetSec": 14,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-21",
          "fact-22",
          "num-16",
          "num-21",
          "num-22",
          "num-23",
          "num-24"
        ],
        "layoutMode": "pipeline",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": [],
        "source": "Larkspur Pay platform team, 14 March 2025"
      }
    ],
    "plantedQuestion": {
      "text": "The store latency went from 1 ms to 80 ms — why did 300 req/s become 12,000 req/s?",
      "beatId": "beat-2",
      "payoffBeatId": "beat-6"
    },
    "rejectedAlternative": {
      "beatId": "beat-3",
      "summary": "Counting per calendar minute allows a client to spend the whole quota in the last second of one minute and again in the first second of the next, up to 2x the limit.",
      "chosenBeatId": "beat-4"
    },
    "ending": {
      "kind": "spec_card_ending",
      "cta": "Share this with a teammate who designs APIs.",
      "specCard": {
        "lines": [
          "Token bucket per caller + route",
          "Refill = elapsed × rate, capped",
          "Shared-store atomic read/write"
        ]
      }
    },
    "missingPrimitiveRequests": []
  }
}
